relations.label: The plucked scherzo returns
relations.basis: The shortened A′ section restores the opening scherzo after the muted middle. The measured pair agrees with the return marked near 290 s; the identity and plucked scoring come from the form and listening notes, not from chroma. CENS diagonal mean 0.942, sustained 19 s, fixed pitch-class shift 0 semitones and time offset 290 s (cache/form/ravel-quartet-scherzo.txt, candidate 1; 0.5 s grid). These are matched excerpts, not complete section boundaries; timing has not been checked by ear.

candidatesRejected: The other two candidates connect a local opening repetition and an overlapping route into A′. They are not separate returns of the entire scherzo. A change between plucking and bowing is not directly inferred from these pitch-class features.
